A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same M2D-LIF study and provide readable text, equations, figures and tables throughout. Neither contains an appendix; both mention separate supplementary material that is absent from the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: v1 reports original linear-probing experiments, detection results and ablations on DroneVehicle, FLIR-aligned and LLVIP.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and reports additional component and illumination-supervision ablation results.

M1.justification: The proposed distillation losses, SimAM attention, illumination prediction, fusion weights and training/inference procedure remain unchanged in Section 3.2 and Equations (1)-(11). Added ablation variants do not revise the proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use DroneVehicle, FLIR-aligned and LLVIP for the same RGB-IR detection tasks and scene coverage. The added ablations use these existing datasets.

E2.justification: Benchmark comparator membership in Tables 1, 4 and 5 is unchanged. Within the ablation comparisons, Table 2 adds a LIF-only comparator and Table 3 adds the variant without L-channel supervision.

E3.justification: Table 2 expands the incremental component comparison into all four M2D/LIF combinations, and Table 3 adds a control disabling L-channel supervision. Existing dataset splits, backbone, optimization settings and detection thresholds remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The added controls test LIF's contribution without distillation and the benefit of illumination supervision beyond learning fusion weights. Existing linear probing, beta sensitivity and qualitative analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, variability estimates or statistical significance tests. The added results retain the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 2 and 3 add LIF-only mAP values of 45.0/68.5/69.4 and no-supervision values of 45.0/69.8/70.3, respectively, ordered FLIR/DroneVehicle/LLVIP. Table 1 revises baseline FLOPs from 116.0 to 116.7G and LIF overhead from 6.4 to 6.5G; Table 5 revises model parameters from 36.6 to 36.5M. Existing benchmark accuracy values and rankings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(11), loss definitions and fusion-weight bounds are mathematically unchanged. Neither version adds proofs or theoretical results; the expanded standard mAP explanation does not introduce new mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same diagnosis of mono-modality underlearning, M2D-LIF contribution, lightweight-fusion advantage and superior detection performance across three datasets.

C2.justification: The explanations of fusion degradation, illumination-dependent complementarity and modality imbalance at large beta remain unchanged. Added ablation gains and overhead percentages quantify existing arguments; no substantive new limitations or mechanism explanations appear.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-repository link in the abstract, explicitly specifies the 0.05 IoU increment for mAP, and identifies FLIR as the cost-profiling dataset in Table 2. The hardware and optimization details in Section 4.2 are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to ViT-CoMer and Zhang et al.'s lane-detection transformer in the introduction. The related-work discussion and positioning against existing multimodal fusion and distillation approaches otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes local grammar and terminology corrections, clarifies the metric explanation, expands the affiliation and adds an acknowledgement. The section order, narrative and most wording are retained.

P2.justification: Tables 2 and 3 gain ablation rows, Table 2 gains parameter/FLOP columns, and table spacing is adjusted. Figure 3's caption and Figure 5's method label are corrected to M2D-LIF. The six figures retain their substantive visual content.

improvement.justification: Compared with v1's raw-L-channel versus full-LIF comparison, v2's no-supervision control better isolates the value of illumination supervision. The code-access link and copyediting also improve usability. These gains are limited by unexplained LIF-only score differences between Tables 1 and 2 and revised Table 1 FLOPs that conflict with retained Section 3.3 prose.
